$comment: Contract for the SetUserActive server-side command (AD-003, AD-041, AD-037/OD-010). Deployed via the registration console (plugins/OutcomeTesting.Registration) and added to the OutcomeTesting solution via a solution-file import (src/customapis/al_SetUserActive). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_SetUserActive
customApi.description: Activates or deactivates an application user (al_user). Deactivation preserves the row and history (OD-010); only al_isactive is flipped. Enforces permission.manage Manage and writes an immutable Audit Event (BR-012).

requestParameters.name: UserId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_user record to activate or deactivate.

requestParameters.name: Active
requestParameters.description: True to reactivate the user, false to deactivate.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same result.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written for this command.
